decision_law: Any open P0 security, managed-schema, availability, or release-provenance finding blocks production certification.

positive_evidence: Authenticated Today, Growth, Accounts, Commercial Cases, Orders and Money surfaces rendered.
Commercial proposals use an eight-stage, human-reviewed workflow and exact-version language.
Security headers and authenticated route boundaries were present in sampled journeys.
blocking_evidence: No independent exact-version cross-system release certificate exists.
A five-minute property-signals cron timed out twice in the sampled 24-hour log window.
Shopify catalog reconciliation failed once in the sampled window.
Canonical Postgres logs show repeated runtime create-table-if-not-exists statements from request paths.
The Vercel prebuild is narrower than the repository's available suite inventory.

positive_evidence: Mutations remain DISABLED_FAIL_CLOSED and external effects remain unauthorized.
Release identity publishes an exact repository SHA and deployment ID.
blocking_evidence: GET /api/v1/healthz returned 503 SECURITY_POSTURE_REQUIRED with 40 expected tables, 39 observed tables and 61 violations.
order_fulfillment_intents is absent from the managed schema.
The production release reports only two applied API schema versions and DEPLOYED_INCOMPLETE.
Safe runtime and worker roles are absent and the managed grants/RLS posture has not converged to the repository migration chain.
GET /api/v1/readyz returned both 200 and 503 during bounded low-volume observation, so dependency readiness is intermittent.
Database TLS is ENCRYPTED_UNVERIFIED.
The API Vercel project is not discoverable in the connected team project inventory even though the domain is serving a deployment.

positive_evidence: The read-only operator plane rendered and bounded its claims.
Cognition, learning and chat evidence are exposed without granting business-write authority.
blocking_evidence: Model routing reported 20 successes from 27 calls, a 0.7407 success rate.
Shopify synchronization is stale.
Google Docs is configured but artifact generation/readback is not verified.
Ask Sultan operator authentication is not configured.
Only four 200 responses were present in the sampled 24-hour Vercel log window, which is insufficient reliability evidence.
Live provider, doctrine and quality campaigns are opt-in and were not release-gate evidence.

positive_evidence: The source schema contains Project, Room, Concept, GeneratedDocument and IntegrationOutbox primitives suitable for a versioned proposal bridge.
Repository CI includes disposable Postgres, Prisma, RLS-lockdown, test, typecheck and build jobs.
blocking_evidence: The production /app route rendered an Unhandled Thrown Response with visible text 200.
Seven 500 responses appeared in the sampled seven-day logs, including bad UUID, session-table and Shopify failures.
Only 1 of 29 public tables has RLS enabled; the remaining 28 produced rls_disabled_in_public errors.
All 29 public tables grant SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES and TRIGGER to anon, authenticated and service_role.
The managed database has not applied the repository's current lockdown migration.
The production deployment is CLI-sourced and has no discoverable Git commit provenance.
CI uses Node 20.19 while Vercel currently runs Node 24.

findings.title: Room Planner public-schema grants and RLS are unsafe
findings.required_action: Contain Data API exposure, revoke broad role privileges, force tenant RLS, run anonymous/authenticated/cross-tenant negative probes, review access logs, and rotate affected session or Shopify credentials if exposure analysis shows they were reachable.

findings.title: Room Planner production application is broken and unprovenanced
findings.required_action: Repair /app, session bootstrap and UUID validation; deploy from an exact Git SHA only after preview tests and rollback rehearsal.

findings.title: API managed schema and least-privilege posture have not converged
findings.required_action: Apply the exact migration chain in a managed preview, provision safe roles, prove denials and rollback, canary the consumers, then promote with exact migration checksums.

findings.title: API dependency readiness is intermittent
findings.required_action: Diagnose pooler, cold-start and database connectivity latency using correlated traces; establish a sustained healthy observation window before certification.

findings.title: Request paths perform runtime schema creation
findings.required_action: Move manual connector and Sultan chat table creation into owned, checksummed migrations and remove request-time DDL.

findings.title: Long-running property-signal work exceeds function limits
findings.required_action: Checkpoint and queue the workload, make it idempotent, and prove bounded retry, dead-letter and reconciliation behavior.

findings.title: Sultan routing and provider evidence is degraded
findings.required_action: Restore routing success, authenticate operators, prove document generation/readback and Shopify freshness, then collect representative quality and reliability windows.

findings.title: No exact-version end-to-end release certification exists
findings.required_action: Certify tenant isolation, lead-to-case-to-proposal-to-quote-to-order-to-fulfillment, room-plan attachment, failure/retry/readback, canary, rollback and restore across exact SHAs.

findings.title: Room-plan proposal consumption is not implemented
findings.required_action: Consume luzione-room-plan-proposal-attachment/v0.1 as proposal evidence before final review, while keeping pricing, send and acceptance authority separate.

findings.title: Licensing has no deployed tenant authority or billing lifecycle
findings.required_action: Review and migrate the API-owned append-versioned license store, add audited provisioning/billing commands, usage metering, grace/cancellation policy and independent entitlement enforcement.

findings.title: Managed Postgres estates have significant advisor debt
findings.required_action: Prioritize unindexed foreign keys, RLS init-plan patterns, mutable search paths, public extensions and duplicate indexes using measured query evidence.

findings.title: Runtime and CI Node versions are not pinned consistently
findings.required_action: Select one supported Node line for CI and runtime, pin it, and add version-drift detection.

performed: authenticated UI and Sultan browser journeys
Vercel deployment, build and runtime-log inspection
Supabase schema, privilege, RLS, migration, log and advisor inspection
local typecheck, lint, 225-test suite, production build and dependency audit
not_performed: production writes or external provider effects
independent consumer implementation of new contracts
